# caputchin_troop_member (Resource)

A user membership in a Caputchin troop. Invitees are identified by email; the membership row is created idempotently for an existing or newly-invited account. Consumes one user seat if the invitee is not already a member of any troop in this account (sharing across troops is free). `troop_id` and `email` are immutable; changing either forces replacement (the underlying row is per-(troop, account) pair). `perms` and `scope` are mutable in place. Stripping every perm is refused server-side (`no-perms-granted`); destroy the resource to remove the member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "caputchin_troop" "marketing" {
  name = "marketing"
}

resource "caputchin_troop_member" "alice" {
  troop_id = caputchin_troop.marketing.id
  email    = "alice@example.com"

  perms = {
    create = true
    edit   = true
    read   = true
    manage = false
  }

  # Grant access across every site in the troop.
  scope = {
    kind = "full"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Invitee email. Immutable (the membership row is keyed by the troop+account pair).
- `perms` (Attributes) Permission set. Stripping every perm is refused. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--perms))
- `scope` (Attributes) Site scope. `kind="full"` grants the perms across all sites in the troop; `kind="partial"` restricts them to the listed `site_ids` (at least one). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `troop_id` (String) Owning troop identifier. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account id of the invitee (resolved server-side by email).
- `id` (String) Server-issued membership identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--perms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `perms`

Required:

- `create` (Boolean) May create site keys / configs in scope.
- `edit` (Boolean) May edit existing site keys / configs in scope.
- `manage` (Boolean) May manage the troop's members and PAT memberships.
- `read` (Boolean) May read site keys / configs / stats in scope.


<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Required:

- `kind` (String) `full` or `partial`.

Optional:

- `site_ids` (List of String) Per-site allowlist. Required (non-empty) when `kind="partial"`; ignored otherwise.
